ping: Check if the bot is still alive
tag: Store and recall snippets of text, with TagScript templating
tagShow: Render a tag and post the result
tagEdit: Change the content of a tag you own
tagRaw: Show the unrendered content of a tag
tagOptionContent: What the tag should say; TagScript is allowed here
tagOptionArgs: Space-separated arguments passed to the tag
tagOptionAuthor: Only list tags made by this user
